violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lettuce=59F, ham=44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Corrected during the inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be properly date marked:Some of the dates on the foods did not have complete dates, with months missing.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Ensure that dates on foods are complete with month, day, and year, for proper monitoring. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at all handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. (CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. ( TOWELS PROVIDED)

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring devices in the food preparation area/kitchen, were found not operating.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. New thermometers were provided during the inspection. Check food thermometers for proper operation daily.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Coffee filters were observed exposed, unprotected at the coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling vents inn the kitchen were dusty and they floor inside the walk-in freezer, is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces, spices, dressings, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Wash Temp for Hot Water Warewashing Machines
violations.observation: The wash water temperature of the hot water sanitizing warewashing machine (under counter units) is not meeting the manufacturer's specifications. The minimum temperature was 150F while the actual temperature swerve 136F and 139F at the 3rd and 2nd floors respectively.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers that use hot water to sanitize may not be less than: 1) 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine, 2) 150F for a stationary rack, dual temperature machine, 3) 160F for a single tank, conveyor, dual temperature machine, or 4) 150F for a multitank, conveyor, multitemperature machine. Do not operate these machine until they have been fixed and operating/sanitizing properly.

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. The internal temperature in the manifold, during the rinse cycle was below 165F. The heated plate test showed 154F on the 3rd floor and 154F on the 2nd floor.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under the main dish washing machine in the kitchen, has a pile of lime buildup and other debris. The floor drains throughout the facility including the upper floors, are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food and tom prevent pest presence

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sinks in the kitchen and at the pantry on the upper level.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specific days (7) allowed: string beans sauce, tomato soup, inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Both were discarded during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a labels in unmarked containers, at the upper level dining room: sugar, brown sugar, flour, baking powder.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. All canisters were properly labeled to identify contents.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: The Randell 2-Tier refrigerator at the pantry upstairs is p;roped using excessive ice build-up on the motor inside, exposing foods to possible contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Repair the refrigeration unit at THYE soonest possible Timor. In the mean time, from the foods that are stored directly under the accumulated ice.
